svgChecks.xmlParse: Both parse with SVG namespace and viewBox. No DOCTYPE/entity declaration.

svgChecks.visualMeaning: English asset uses blue background, diagonal white/red saltires and central white/red cross, identifying the UK flag. French asset has left blue, centre white, right red vertical thirds. Neither depends on emoji/font glyph availability.
svgChecks.aspectRatio: English viewBox60×30 gives2:1; French3×2 gives3:2. background-size:contain preserves those ratios inside24×16 instead of distorting them.
svgChecks.actualPixelRender: Not executed. Local static XML/geometry/colour inspection only; no native browser, suite or new capture was run.
